name: Berenica
bio: Fights with a sword and dual pistols, detonating Umbro-aligned area attacks for high burst damage.

skills.name: Faintlight
skills.desc: Rush forward, dealing AoE Damage 4 times along the way.

skills.name: Netherflames
skills.desc: Switches the melee weapon to [Ymir] and casts 1 Swordwave. When performing Normal Attack using [Ymir], unleashes Swordwaves in the attacking direction and constantly consumes Sanity, during which Berenica is immune to Hitstun when taking damage. Once Sanity reaches 0 or the skill is used again, [Ymir] is sheathed.

skills.name: Recuperation
skills.desc: When dealing damage with [Faintlight] or Sword, there is a chance to restore Sanity.

skills.name: Afterburn
skills.desc: After using [Netherflames], the next use of [Faintlight] will not consume Sanity.

skills.name: Heart Devourer
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases ATK for the character and their nearby Umbro teammate(s).
